source_records.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash
source_records.summary_text: Google first-party announcement, model card, and API documentation identify Gemini 3.7 Flash as a 2026-08-13 workhorse model for coding and agents, with native multimodal inputs and documented tool/capability support including function calling, code execution, preview computer use, and configurable thinking. Pricing and comparative performance remain Google-attributed.
